protocol.matrix: 2 activations x 2 dtypes x 3 shapes; K=64; 5 F06 arms with matching v14 selection layer
protocol.mapping: For core and native use the same physical card for each (template, dtype, shape). One cold process and private Torch/Triton caches per case. Eight devices initially idle. No parallel timed workloads on any card.

tags.official: official compiler and library with v14 F06
tags.stage: v14 with SDNN preparation and restoration reconnected
tags.full: stage with explicit resource_kind=sdnn recognized in precision lowering
tags.official_native: native Inductor, upstream FlagTree plus P800 target normalization only
tags.current_native: native Inductor, v14 FlagTree plus the same target normalization only

protocol.timer: Synchronized caller wall latency in microseconds. Independent eager/compiled alternating AB and BA. Drop 8 warmup pairs and take separate medians of 48 pairs. Native error cases have no usable timing.
protocol.gating: F06 admission unchanged: full candidate pool, special values, storage and graph checks, 2 independent 128-sample public rounds. Independent final random inputs and NaN/Inf checks before timing.
protocol.timeouts: 104s core, 175s cold retry, 110s raw native or MatMul+Bias. Attempts recorded including failures. A retry is a separate cold compilation, may choose another schedule.
